$comment: Provenance for a VENDORED third-party plugin. Read by .github/workflows/sync-vendored-plugins.yml, which opens a PR when upstream moves. Do not edit by hand except to change what is tracked.
author: Adobe
why: Claude Desktop on 3P only fetches marketplace plugins whose source is local to the marketplace repository. Adobe's plugin is listed in anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins as a cross-repo git-subdir source, so an admin-configured marketplace lists it but never downloads it. Vendoring the content here makes the source local and therefore fetchable. See roadmap#509.
